connector.name: CrustAPI Google + LinkedIn Data
connector.registryDescription: Live Google + public LinkedIn data: search, maps, profiles, companies, jobs. Pay only for results.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package crustapi-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.crustapi, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
